subject.title: fix(ci): enforce plugin SDK API baseline

question: Should historical-target validation skip this check only when the selected target predates the script, while baseline-only manifest changes are explicitly routed into generated-contract validation?
rationale: The safe implementation depends on the repository's intended historical-validation contract and CI-routing policy; an unconditional fail-closed shard contradicts the existing compatibility concern, while a broad skip could weaken the new enforcement.

options.title: Preserve compatible enforcement
options.body: Pass the historical-target compatibility fact into the additional shard, skip only unavailable historical scripts, and route baseline-only manifests through the API baseline check with regression guards.

options.title: Accept historical-target failures
options.body: Keep the unconditional check and explicitly retire historical-target support for targets without the script.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatible enforcement
recommendation.body: Pass the historical-target compatibility fact into the additional shard, skip only unavailable historical scripts, and route baseline-only manifests through the API baseline check with regression guards.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged SDK-surface and configuration work provides the closest available evidence of ownership for this baseline policy.
